verdict.rationale: Caveman ships its own agent and hosts others (Claude Agent, Codex, Cursor), so plugging in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions MCP or connecting to MCP servers. The closest item, "Plugins from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor", describes an adjacent plugin feature and does not document MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
